item.title: A Joint Statement Calling for Closure of Guantánamo after 24 Years
item.description: Ahead of the 24th anniversary of Guantánamo’s opening, 116 organizations signed this statement led by CVT and the Center for Constitutional Rights reaffirming that it must be closed, without repurposing it for any future detention regime, and that there must be redress for individuals who were held and whose rights were violated. The post A Joint Statement Calling for Closure of Guantánamo after 24 Years appeared first on Maryknoll Office of Global Concerns.

item.title: Maryknoll Office for Global Concerns Celebrates the Court’s Decision to Block the End of TPS for Haitians
item.description: The Maryknoll Office for Global Concerns welcomes the court decision to maintain deportation protections for over 350,000 Haitians living in the United States. We recognize this decision as an important affirmation of human dignity, and reaffirm our commitment to working with Congress and the Administration to secure permanent protections and a pathway to residency for Haitian TPS holders who have long called this country home.
